messages:
Priya Malik: Quick sync — now that the streaming beta is live, we need to decide next 2-week slice. Options: (A) triage/patch high-sev bugs (RDW-3482, RDW-3499), (B) perf hotfix (reduce tail latency), (C) UX onboarding polish. Customers asking for latency + stability. TL;DR: need decision.

Jordan Lee: :eyes: My vote: A + small perf patch. Recommend reserving ~30% of sprint capacity for hotfixes, 70% for enhancements. Data: 4 customers reported p95 spikes this week.

Kevin O'Neill: Agree. From eng: perf win possible by adjusting batching policy + KV cache TTL — est 2 dev-days. RDW-3482 (memory leak) needs immediate patch, ~3 dev-days with tests. If we do both, we'll cut polish scope.

Maya Chen: Design: onboarding polish is small (1-2 days) if we limit to copy changes + tooltip. Can ship with perf patch.

Priya Malik: Sales flagged Acmecorp wants 99.9% latency SLO under 100ms. We can't promise that right now. Proposed plan: 1) Immediate bug patch; 2) perf hotfix rolled as 20% canary; 3) reserve postmortem + guardrails. Thoughts?

Jordan Lee: Process suggestion: add labels 'postlaunch-critical', 'postlaunch-enhance', 'canary-ready' on the board. I'll draft customer comms template.

Kevin O'Neill: For Acme SLO, present tradeoffs: quantization vs accuracy and dedicated capacity option. Current metrics: p50 45ms, p95 220ms. Tail caused by large batch spikes. Suggest exposing 'burst-cap' toggle + recommended config.

Maya Chen: :+1: on comms. Template should include short apology, summary of fix, ETA, workaround (set batch_limit=1).

eng-oncall-bot: INCIDENT RDW-3482 created by Kevin O'Neill — status: investigating.

Priya Malik: Decision check — Approve 'bug triage + perf hotfix' with canary. If no objections by EOD, Jordan owns roadmap change, Kevin owns deployment, Maya owns comms. :thumbsup: 

Jordan Lee: :+1:

Kevin O'Neill: :+1: I'll spin up canary job tomorrow 9am PT.

Kevin O'Neill: Rollout command:
```
rdwctl deploy --canary 20 --image streaming:v1.2.3
```

Maya Chen: I'll draft comms now and share: https://notion.redwood/comm/rdw-3482

Priya Malik: Thanks — add acceptance criteria to tickets: no increase in error rates, p95 improved >=30%, pass regression suite. I'll add to RDW-3499.
